question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：海地 vs 苏格兰（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Haiti vs Scotland (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 苏格兰凭 234 分 Elo 差距明显占优，但 Gilmour 伤退与海地归化补强让胜率略低于纯模型值。
one_liner_en: Scotland are clear favourites on a 234-point Elo gap, but Gilmour's absence and Haiti's diaspora reinforcements trim them slightly below the raw model.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 234 分（苏格兰 1782 vs 海地 1548），统计模型给苏格兰约 62% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 234-point Elo gap (Scotland 1782 vs Haiti 1548) gives Scotland a ~62% baseline win probability in the statistical model.

key_reasons.cn: 苏格兰中场核心 Gilmour 伤退整届赛事（5-30 受伤），前锋 Adams 大腿伤势存疑，削弱中前场。
key_reasons.en: Scotland midfielder Billy Gilmour is out of the tournament (injured May 30) and forward Che Adams is a fitness doubt, weakening midfield and attack.

key_reasons.cn: 海地获 Isidor（桑德兰）、Bellegarde（狼队）等旅欧新援补强，Elo 对其反映滞后；热身 4-0 胜新西兰。
key_reasons.en: Haiti added European-based recruits Isidor (Sunderland) and Bellegarde (Wolves) that Elo has not yet absorbed, and beat New Zealand 4-0 in warm-ups.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 0.161/0.221/0.618; bounded evidence adjustment (Scotland -4.0pp, Haiti +2.5pp, Draw +1.5pp; sums to zero) -> p_final 0.185/0.235/0.580. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. No market inputs of any kind.
